// Recording reverse proxy for the harness session-id capture (jyx.52). Copy it
// to main.go in a scratch dir outside the repo to build it. Forwards
// /anthropic/* and /openai/* to the vendors and appends one JSON line per
// request with redacted headers and a content-stripped body skeleton.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

var secretHeaders = map[string]bool{
	"authorization": true, "x-api-key": true, "api-key": true, "cookie": true,
	"openai-organization": true, "openai-project": true, "chatgpt-account-id": true,
}

// keepKeys are body keys whose string values are kept verbatim (ids,
// enums, routing); every other string becomes "<str:N>".
var keepKeys = map[string]bool{
	"model": true, "role": true, "type": true, "id": true, "name": true,
	"tool_use_id": true, "tool_call_id": true, "call_id": true,
	"user_id": true, "user": true, "session_id": true, "conversation_id": true,
	"previous_response_id": true, "prompt_cache_key": true, "safety_identifier": true,
	"conversation": true, "store": true, "stream": true, "tool_choice": true,
	"cache_control": true, "ttl": true, "effort": true, "reasoning": true,
	"service_tier": true, "truncation": true, "finish_reason": true, "stop_reason": true,
	"media_type": true, "format": true, "summary": true,
}

var (
	mu  sync.Mutex
	out *os.File
	seq int
)

func skeleton(v interface{}, key string, depth int) interface{} {
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		m := map[string]interface{}{}
		for k, vv := range t {
			// metadata maps are kept whole (that is what we are looking for),
			// but long strings inside are still clipped.
			if k == "metadata" {
				m[k] = clip(vv)
				continue
			}
			m[k] = skeleton(vv, k, depth+1)
		}
		return m
	case []interface{}:
		// Keep at most 50 items so huge histories stay readable.
		n := len(t)
		lim := n
		if lim > 50 {
			lim = 50
		}
		arr := make([]interface{}, 0, lim+1)
		for _, x := range t[:lim] {
			arr = append(arr, skeleton(x, key, depth+1))
		}
		if n > lim {
			arr = append(arr, fmt.Sprintf("<+%d more>", n-lim))
		}
		return arr
	case string:
		if keepKeys[key] && len(t) <= 300 {
			return t
		}
		return fmt.Sprintf("<str:%d>", len(t))
	default:
		return t
	}
}

func clip(v interface{}) interface{} {
	switch t := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		m := map[string]interface{}{}
		for k, vv := range t {
			m[k] = clip(vv)
		}
		return m
	case string:
		if len(t) > 400 {
			return t[:400] + fmt.Sprintf("<+%d>", len(t)-400)
		}
		return t
	default:
		return t
	}
}

func redactHeaders(h http.Header) map[string]string {
	m := map[string]string{}
	for k, vs := range h {
		v := strings.Join(vs, ", ")
		if secretHeaders[strings.ToLower(k)] {
			v = fmt.Sprintf("<redacted:%d>", len(v))
		}
		m[k] = v
	}
	return m
}

func main() {
	addr := flag.String("addr", "127.0.0.1:47911", "listen address")
	file := flag.String("out", "capture.jsonl", "output file")
	label := flag.String("label", "", "default run label (overridden by /label)")
	flag.Parse()
	var err error
	out, err = os.OpenFile(*file, os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	cur := *label

	targets := map[string]*url.URL{
		"/anthropic": mustURL("https://api.anthropic.com"),
		"/openai":    mustURL("https://api.openai.com"),
	}
	http.HandleFunc("/__label", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		cur = r.URL.Query().Get("l")
		mu.Unlock()
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "ok")
	})
	http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var prefix string
		var target *url.URL
		for p, u := range targets {
			if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, p+"/") {
				prefix, target = p, u
			}
		}
		if target == nil {
			http.Error(w, "unknown route", 404)
			return
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body))
		rec := map[string]interface{}{
			"t":       time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
			"method":  r.Method,
			"path":    r.URL.Path,
			"query":   r.URL.RawQuery,
			"headers": redactHeaders(r.Header),
			"bytes":   len(body),
		}
		var parsed interface{}
		if json.Unmarshal(body, &parsed) == nil {
			rec["body"] = skeleton(parsed, "", 0)
		}
		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
			Director: func(req *http.Request) {
				req.URL.Scheme = target.Scheme
				req.URL.Host = target.Host
				req.URL.Path = strings.TrimPrefix(req.URL.Path, prefix)
				req.Host = target.Host
			},
			FlushInterval: -1,
			ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
				rec["status"] = resp.StatusCode
				rh := map[string]string{}
				for _, k := range []string{"Content-Type", "Request-Id", "X-Request-Id", "Openai-Processing-Ms", "Anthropic-Organization-Id"} {
					if v := resp.Header.Get(k); v != "" {
						rh[k] = v
					}
				}
				rec["resp_headers"] = rh
				return nil
			},
		}
		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		mu.Lock()
		seq++
		rec["seq"] = seq
		rec["label"] = cur
		b, _ := json.Marshal(rec)
		out.Write(append(b, '\n'))
		mu.Unlock()
	})
	log.Printf("listening on %s", *addr)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(*addr, nil))
}

func mustURL(s string) *url.URL {
	u, err := url.Parse(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return u
}
